contentOpsRules.benchmark: mytravelnotes.co.kr structural benchmark; do not copy article text or images verbatim
titlePatterns: 장소 + 핵심 변수 3개 + 방문 전 확인 포인트
articleTemplate: FAQ where search intent is informational
subcategoryOperations: top header axes expose children in a click-to-open mega dropdown
category pages rely on the header dropdown instead of repeating subcategory cards
category pages keep booking intent links close to the first fold
large categories paginate with stable static URLs
cards preserve image, category label, title, excerpt, date, read time, and popularity signal
monetization: AdSense in-article top and after intro
booking hubs for hotels, flights, activities, deals
affiliate redirect pages with click logging
seasonal articles that route to booking checks
public feeds and sitemaps for indexing

apiAndDataSources: public RSS feed under /api/feed static mirror
titleRules: 도시명 + 여행 목적 + 숙소 위치 + 예약 전 확인사항
해외 글은 항공권·숙소·투어를 제목에 함께 노출
축제 글은 날짜·장소·근처 숙소 체크를 포함
호텔/항공/투어 페이지는 예약 전 비교 의도를 제목에 포함
